title: Vintage Americana 4th of July Painting Set | Printable Wall Art Set
description_html:
Celebrate summer with this beautiful vintage Americana 4th of July painting set! This set of 3 coordinating watercolor prints brings a tasteful, classic summer aesthetic to your home decor, featuring subtle patriotic touches like blue hydrangeas, red and white gingham, and rustic farmhouse details.

What You Get:
High-resolution (300 DPI) JPG files in 5 size ratios for easy framing:

  • 2:3 ratio (for 4x6, 12x18, 24x36)
  • 3:4 ratio (for 9x12, 18x24)
  • 4:5 ratio (for 8x10, 16x20)
  • 11x14 inches
  • ISO (A4, A3, A2)

How to Print:
Instantly download your files after purchase. Print at home using high-quality matte cardstock or heavy watercolor paper for an authentic painting look. Alternatively, send the files to your favorite local print shop or an online printing service.

Please note: This is a digital download. No physical items will be shipped. This Printable Wall Art Set is for personal use only.
